headline: Archetype Cards, from entry to detail
overview: Draw from 72 symbolic archetype cards using different reading methods to gain insight into your inner world and patterns.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Draw from a deck of 72 symbolic archetype cards
Multiple reading methods to suit different intentions
Rich symbolic meanings and interpretations for each card
Reflect on patterns and themes revealed by your draws
tips: Set a clear intention or question before drawing cards to get more meaningful results.
Journal your reflections after each reading to track recurring archetypes over time.
